author: Patrick20242023
source_note: 采用2024弥陀殿实拍。保留七间八柱、单檐歇山、台基与中央阶梯；首稿细节过密，内置编辑减少瓦垄及门窗纹样。
prompt: Edit image 1 (Chongfu Amitabha Hall draft) using image 2 solely as the line STYLE MASTER. Preserve the actual architecture exactly: seven bays, eight columns, one very wide roof and same roof ornaments, same single front stair. Change ONLY line economy and framing. Scale the entire hall down about 12% so there is generous white space on all four sides and neither roof tip crowds the frame. DELETE almost all roof tile lines: the roof surface should be a huge WHITE empty plane, with only FOUR light short curves across the entire roof to suggest roofing. DELETE the dense tiny lattice meshes, keep just 2–3 large sparse geometric motifs per window panel and main rectangular frames. Simplify every bracket cluster to a few main outlines and remove tiny repetitive details. Keep all openings white, no shading whatsoever, no gray, no hatching. Use very fine organic lines like image 2, not a detailed blueprint. Retain the Jin hall's broad low silhouette, 7 bays / 8 columns, ornaments, stair, and weathered old structure. Nothing else.

site_recommendation.yearNote: 采用现存弥陀殿营建纪年；殿内彩绘、塑像与后世修缮另有分期。
site_recommendation.lede: 宽阔低缓的屋顶落在七间柱网上，檐下铺作疏朗而厚重。崇福寺弥陀殿将金代木构与殿内彩塑、壁画保存于同一空间。
facts: 弥陀殿始建于金皇统三年（1143），图版按现存殿宇断代。
面阔七间、进深四间，单檐歇山顶；正面八柱分出清楚的柱网。
本图选弥陀殿正面，省去庭院供具与植被；殿内彩塑和壁画未绘入。
